confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from five web searches. They were mainly 2026 Numbeo-derived aggregates republished by secondary sites, plus Expatistan and bar-price guides. Meal, coffee and beer figures were consistent across sources (the two-person mid-range meal was nudged up from about $80). Cocktail and wine are less certain because sources mixed older bar guides, national benchmarks and happy-hour data, so I used regular menu prices at roughly 2x and 1.7x the beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge (no accommodation searches or listing checks) for a July low-season window. Tampa has very thin hostel supply, so the hostel prices are proxies. The FX value came from an RBA exchange-rate search result and was not independently re-verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Florida/US Sun Belt city. Food and drink are anchored on Tampa-specific aggregates. Accommodation is reasoned from general knowledge of comparable Florida markets such as Orlando and Jacksonville, with Miami as a higher-cost reference. Hostel prices are proxied from those markets because Tampa has few hostels.
